'''Asuka Iwashita''' (Japanese: '''{{j|岩下明日香}}''') is a conceptual character artist for {{aniseries|PTS}}, specifically the [[M06|sixth,]] [[M07|seventh,]] and [[M12|twelfth]] Pokémon movies. In addition to these three movies, she worked on the special episode ''[[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon]]''.

In addition to working on ''Pokémon the Series'', Iwashita worked as a graphic designer for multiple Pokémon games from {{game|Gold and Silver|s}} through {{game|Emerald}}. In addition to being a designer for the games' graphics, she is also credited for designing Pokémon in [[Generation III]].

As an illustrator for the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]], Asuka Iwashita illustrated {{PAGESINCATEGORY:Illus. by Asuka Iwashita}} cards, beginning in 2001. Her first illustrations were featured in {{TCG|Pokémon VS}}, in which she illustrated all of [[Sabrina]]'s featured Pokémon. In 2004, three years after illustrating these cards, she was credited as an illustrator for the last time on {{TCG ID|EX Deoxys|Makuhita|65}}.
